FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Does the NIS2 directive apply to me?

NIS2 significantly widens the range of regulated companies, mainly those with 50+ employees or €10M+ turnover in certain sectors. Smaller companies are often affected indirectly too, because their customers require security evidence from suppliers. We clarify your situation in the first call.

What does a project with EMETRIX Tech cost?

It depends on scope. After a free consultation you receive a written quote with a fixed price or a clearly defined hour budget. No surprises.

Do you work remotely?

Yes. Most services are delivered fully remotely and securely. For on-site work we are quickly with you in the Rhine-Main area, and Germany-wide by arrangement.

What if we have an active security incident?

Email us immediately with the subject "EMERGENCY". We help with containment, analysis and recovery, and support you with reporting duties under GDPR and NIS2.

Do you build accessible websites?

Yes. Since June 2025 the European Accessibility Act (in Germany: BFSG) applies to many online services. We build to WCAG 2.2 and audit existing sites for conformance.

Which languages do you work in?

German, English and Persian (Farsi/Dari). We also create documentation and websites in these languages.
